presets.name: Observe everything
presets.description: Check every answer and record what would have happened, without changing any response.

presets.name: Flag risky answers
presets.description: Deliver every answer and tell your app which ones look risky, through X-TrustAgent-* response headers.

presets.name: Block contradictions
presets.description: Block answers that your documents contradict or do not support, when two signals agree. Streams are buffered so a block can replace the answer.
